lines.say: In twenty eighteen, a message in a bottle washed up in Australia.
caps: In *2018,* a message in a bottle

lines.say: It was thrown overboard from a German ship in eighteen eighty-six.
One hundred and thirty-one years at sea.
The note asked the finder to write back.
Message Health would have sent it by text and email. In seconds. Not a hundred and thirty-one years.
Somewhere, a bottle is still waiting for a reply.
